annotations.title: Request financing from the Janover desk

description: Send a financing request to the Janover desk on behalf of a person who asked you to, through the same intake as https://www.opportunityzones.help/get-financing/. Use it only when the person asked for it and agreed to be contacted. For business-purpose debt for real estate projects, including Opportunity Zone projects held through a Qualified Opportunity Fund or other entity: construction, acquisition, bridge and permanent loans. Janover arranges loans; it does not sell or recommend fund interests. Not for consumer loans or a home the borrower lives in. It takes contact details and the loan request only: never send a Social Security number, date of birth, credit, bank or income information. Returns an acknowledgement that the request was received. It is not an application approval, a rate quote or a commitment to lend.

business_purpose.description: Must be true: the loan is for business or investment purposes, not personal, family or household use

contact_consent.description: Must be true, and only if the person named agreed to this statement: By submitting, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and you consent to receive calls, texts, and emails from Janover Capital about your inquiry at the contact information provided, including via automated technology. Consent is not a condition of any service. Reply STOP to opt out of texts; message and data rates may apply.

details.description: Optional deal facts: units or size, occupancy, NOI, current debt, timing. No personal financial data

email.description: Email address where the person can be reached

first_name.description: First name of the person requesting financing

loan_amount.description: Approximate loan amount in dollars; an estimate is fine

not_a_residence.description: Must be true: the loan is not secured by a home that an owner, guarantor or family member lives or will live in

property_location.description: City and state of the property (optional)

purchase_stage.description: Required when loan_purpose is purchase: how far along the purchase is

role.description: Borrower/investor, or a broker acting for one (optional)
